text: ## Food & Beverages

1. Eight veg meal services for patients are served complimentary for all room categories as per  Dietician's approval. In case of any additional food requirement would be charged separately.  (Non-Veg meal is strictly prohibited from outside)
2. Request for Jain meals for patients (to dietician) / relatives (to pantry) should be made in advance.
3. Four veg meal services only for one attendant of Suite / Premium Deluxe class are complimentary. Any  food item ordered from room service menu will be chargeable.
4. For Daycare patient two veg meal services for patients are served complimentary as per Dietician's  approval. In case of any additional food requirement would be charged separately.
5. Room service facility is available for the relatives of patients admitted in the room.
6. We strictly prohibit outside food to ensure patients speedy recovery & wellness. (Under no  circumstances outside food & beverage will be allowed for patient or relative).
EXTN NO: Pantry - 6630 / 6631  Dietician - 6635 (7 am To 7 pm)

## Discharge & Refund

7. Discharge procedure will take approximately 2hrs after Doctors Consultation and written  Instruction (May vary from case to case). For TPA discharges, it would take upto 5-6 hours depending  on the final approval from the TPA.
8. At the time of discharge, passes should be surrendered to the discharge counter.

9. Original Bill Summary, Detailed Bill and Settlement copy will be given from the billing counter.  Medicines, Reports and Discharge Summary will be handed over by the nurse on duty.  EXTN NO: TPA:- 6035, Cashier:- 6040.  Billing - 6031, Admission - 6032
